verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a data platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack describes only Databricks-managed offerings: pay-as-you-go cloud pricing, a hosted Free Edition workspace, and serverless compute. Nothing documents a self-hostable or on-premises deployment of the core product. Community remarks about DIY or self-hosted Spark concern other tools, not a Databricks capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
